reason: A DeepSeek Harness development utility that lets an agent reload one MCP or in-process plugin entry without restarting the host, with dry-run matching and failure rollback described in the README.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 reload_plugin 工具，可在不重启宿主的情况下重新加载单个 MCP 或进程内插件条目。
summaries.en: Provides a reload_plugin tool for reloading a single MCP or in-process DeepSeek Harness plugin entry without restarting the host.

capabilities: Matches a single non-group loader entry by id, module name, or MCP serverName
Respawns an MCP server child process and re-registers its tools
Hard-reloads an in-process plugin by clearing module caches and re-importing code
Supports dry-run inspection and rollback after failed re-import or re-apply
